candidates.description: This feature vector represents common suffixes and root components found in Hindi and Urdu vocabulary.
This feature vector represents common Hindi suffixes, prefixes, and partial word fragments.
This vector represents various Hindi consonant-vowel combinations and character fragments written in the Devanagari script.
This feature vector represents common suffixes, characters, and sub-word components frequently found in Hindi text.
These tokens are common Hindi verb roots and inflectional suffixes used to form action words and tense markers.
This feature vector activates on dependent vowel signs and punctuation marks from the Devanagari script.
This vector represents common suffixes and endings in Indo-Aryan languages like Hindi and Sanskrit.
This vector activates on common Hindi vowel matras and hyphenation punctuation.
This vector is related to Hindi vowel matras attached to punctuation marks.
This feature vector activates on common Hindi subword tokens and Devanagari characters.
